title: Understanding Linear Regression Assumptions: Linearity, Homoscedasticity & More

cues.en: Instructor: Hello, welcome back to the course.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎回到課程。

cues.en: Super excited to have you on board.
cues.zh: 很高興你繼續參與。

cues.en: Today we've got a very interesting and important tutorial, assumptions of linear regression.
cues.zh: 今天的主題很有趣也很重要：線性迴歸的假設。

cues.en: So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: Here, we've got a data set with a linear regression applied and this linear regression seems to be serving its purpose really well.
cues.zh: 這份資料套用了線性迴歸，看起來相當適合，也達成目的。

cues.en: However, if we look at the following three data sets, we can see that a linear regression is applied each time and in fact, it's exactly the same linear regression as in the first case.
cues.zh: 但下面三份資料也都套用線性迴歸，而且其實和第一個例子是完全相同的迴歸線。

cues.en: However, those linear regressions are not serving their purpose, in fact they are misleading.
cues.zh: 然而，這些線性迴歸卻沒有達成目的，甚至具有誤導性。

cues.en: So we shouldn't be using linear regressions in those situations.
cues.zh: 因此，這些情況不該直接用線性迴歸。

cues.en: These four data sets are called the Anscombe's quartet and they illustrate that you can't just simply, blindly apply linear regression, you have to make sure that your data set
cues.zh: 這四份資料叫做 Anscombe 四重奏，說明不能盲目套用線性迴歸，必須先確保資料集

cues.en: is fit for using linear regression.
cues.zh: 適合這種方法。

cues.en: And that's where assumptions of linear regression come in.
cues.zh: 這就需要檢查線性迴歸的假設。

cues.en: So let's have a look at them.
cues.zh: 一起來看。

cues.en: There's going to be five assumptions in total plus an extra check.
cues.zh: 共有五個假設，外加一項檢查。

cues.en: The first assumption is linearity.
cues.zh: 第一個是線性。

cues.en: We want to make sure that there is a linear relationship between our dependent variable and each independent variable.
cues.zh: 必須確保依變數與各自變數之間存在線性關係。

cues.en: And if you look at the chart here on the right, you'll see that the linear regression is misleading.
cues.zh: 右圖的線性迴歸具有誤導性。

cues.en: There is actually no linear relationship between the two variables.
cues.zh: 兩個變數其實沒有線性關係。

cues.en: So we wouldn't use this kind of model there.
cues.zh: 所以這裡不會使用這種模型。

cues.en: The second assumption is homoscedasticity.
cues.zh: 第二個是同方差性。

cues.en: And even though it sounds like a complex term, it actually simply means equal variance.
cues.zh: 聽起來複雜，其實就是變異數相同。

cues.en: Meaning that you don't want to see a cone type shape on your chart whether an increasing cone or a decreasing cone.
cues.zh: 我們不希望圖上出現擴張或收縮的錐形分布。

cues.en: Which would mean that variance is dependent on the independent variable.
cues.zh: 因為那表示變異數隨自變數改變。

cues.en: So in this case, we wouldn't use a linear regression either.
cues.zh: 因此，這種情況也不適合直接使用線性迴歸。

cues.en: The third assumption is multivariate normality or normality of error distribution.
cues.zh: 第三個是多變量常態性，或誤差分布的常態性。

cues.en: If you look at the chart here on the right, you can feel that something is off.
cues.zh: 看右邊圖表，會覺得有點不對勁。

cues.en: The best way to intuitively think about it is if you look along the line of the linear regression, you want to see a normal distribution of your data point.
cues.zh: 直覺上，可以沿著迴歸線看過去，希望資料點呈現常態分布。

cues.en: In the case on the right here, we can see something different.
cues.zh: 但右圖的情況不同。

cues.en: And so, again, we wouldn't apply a linear regression there.
cues.zh: 因此，同樣不會直接套用線性迴歸。

cues.en: The fourth assumption is independence of observations.
cues.zh: 第四個是觀測值的獨立性。

cues.en: And this includes the term no autocorrelation.
cues.zh: 這也包含沒有自我相關。

cues.en: Sometimes you'll see the assumption titled as no autocorrelation.
cues.zh: 有時這個假設就直接叫無自我相關。

cues.en: And what that means is that we don't want to see any kind of pattern in our data.
cues.zh: 意思是不希望資料中出現這種規律模式。

cues.en: A pattern in the data, like we see here, indicates that our rows are not independent, that some rows are affecting other rows and other rows, et cetera.
cues.zh: 像這裡的模式，表示各列並非獨立，某些列會影響其他列，而後者又影響其他列。

cues.en: A classic example of this would be the stock market where previous prices affect future prices, which affect future prices and so on.
cues.zh: 典型例子是股市，先前價格影響之後價格，後者再影響更後面的價格。

cues.en: So in this case, we wouldn't apply a linear regression model.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，也不會直接使用一般線性迴歸模型。

cues.en: The fifth assumption is lack of multicollinearity.
cues.zh: 第五個是沒有多重共線性。

cues.en: Basically, we want our independent variables or predictors not to be correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 基本上，希望自變數，也就是預測因子，不要彼此高度相關。

cues.en: If they're not correlated, then we can build a linear regression.
cues.zh: 如果不相關，就可以建立線性迴歸。

cues.en: If they are correlated, then if we do proceed and build a linear regression model, then the coefficient estimates that we get in the model will become unreliable.
cues.zh: 若彼此相關，仍建立模型，就可能使係數估計不可靠。

cues.en: And the sixth point is the outlier check.
cues.zh: 第六點是離群值檢查。

cues.en: This is not an actual assumption but rather an extra check that is important to keep in mind when building linear regression models.
cues.zh: 這不是正式假設，而是建立線性迴歸時應記得的額外檢查。

cues.en: If you look at the chart here on the right, you can see that the outlier is significantly affecting the linear regression line that we get.
cues.zh: 右圖可以看到，離群值明顯影響得到的迴歸線。

cues.en: So something that we want to consider is, should we remove the outliers before building a linear regression or do we want to build a linear regression
cues.zh: 所以要考慮，建立模型前是否應移除離群值，還是要

cues.en: with the outliers included?
cues.zh: 保留它們一起建模。

cues.en: This will depend on your business knowledge and knowledge of the data set.
cues.zh: 這要依商業知識與對資料集的理解決定。

cues.en: So there we go, those are the assumptions of linear regression.
cues.zh: 這些就是線性迴歸的假設。

cues.en: In this course, we're going to assume by default that they are correct for all the data sets that we work with.
cues.zh: 本課程會預設所用資料集都滿足這些假設。

cues.en: However, when you're working with your own data sets, it's important to do these checks to make sure you're building a linear regression when it is fit for the data set.
cues.zh: 但處理自己的資料時，務必檢查，確保資料確實適合線性迴歸。

cues.en: And to finish off this tutorial I have a special bonus for you.
cues.zh: 最後，送你一個小贈品。

cues.en: If you enjoyed this explanation, you can download the PDF version of this slide and keep it at home printed out as a poster.
cues.zh: 如果喜歡這份說明，可以下載這張投影片的 PDF，印成海報放在家裡。

cues.en: Keep it somewhere handy for those times when you do need to check assumptions of linear regression.
cues.zh: 放在隨手能看到的地方，需要時就能檢查線性迴歸假設。

cues.en: If that's something that you would like to have, head over to superdatascience.com/assumptions and you can download your poster there.
cues.zh: 想取得的話，到 superdatascience.com/assumptions 下載海報。

cues.en: And I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
